job.value: review and edit saved searches and card deal alerts

arrivedFrom.value: 'Manage' in the Good Deal 'Notification set' sheet

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The title 'Saved Searches' over a list of queries with filter counts makes the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The rows and the 'Edit' control are the main elements; nothing competes.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Top rows have only a chevron while 'Trading cards' rows have both a pencil and a chevron, with no hint how those two taps differ.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: The red count badges ('12', '99+') aren't labelled as new listings, and 'Good Deals' appears as a row subtitle unexplained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing needs deciding beyond which search to open or edit.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Search filters are summarised ('+1 filter applied', 'Graded · under $3,000') rather than listed in full.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: 'Pikachu 58/102 Base Set' appears both in the main list and under 'Trading cards', so two alert systems show up side by side.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Short row titles and subtitles only.
